challenge.method: Check RFC 4180 section 2 items 1 through 7 and inspect the pinned Linguist cars.csv as raw data. Contrast its line ending bytes, the RFC's common CRLF convention, and RFC 7111 fragment selection.
challenge.results: The independently reacquired 68-byte sample matches the pinned Git blob and SHA-256. It contains three LF bytes and no CR bytes. That single specimen illustrates line-ending variation under a common-layout description. RFC 7111 adds selection behavior at the URI fragment boundary.

limitations: The sample observation is supported by the retained pinned file and separate acquisition, while the RFC binding supports the common-layout description.
The sample and RFC do not establish a universal line-ending rule or a parser conformance result.
